c74object.name: el.bashfest~
c74object.digest: Algorithmic sample-accurate buffer processor with randomized DSP routines
c74object.description: el.bashfest~ is triggered by signal clicks in the left inlet to playback samples from an associated buffer while dynamically applying a randomized chain of algorithmic DSP processes (such as transposition, ring modulation, filtering, comb delays, and granular flams).

inlet.description: A non-zero signal impulse (click) triggers a new playback and processing event. The amplitude of the click scales the event's volume.
Optional signal controlling the transposition factor for each triggered note.

objarg.name: buffername
objarg.description: The name of the target buffer~ containing source audio data.

objarg.name: size
objarg.description: Maximum work buffer duration in milliseconds (default: 4000.0 ms).

objarg.name: latency
objarg.description: Wait time in samples required for internal offline DSP processing (default: 8192 samples).

objarg.name: voices
objarg.description: Maximum number of simultaneous polyphonic voices to avoid note stealing (default: 8).

method.name: stop
method.description: Terminates all currently active processing events immediately.

method.name: flatodds
method.description: Sets the probability weight for all 20 internal DSP processes to be equal.

method.name: soloproc
method.description: Sets the odds of the specified process index to 1.0 and mutes all other processes.

method.name: killproc
method.description: Sets the probability weight of the specified process index to zero.

method.name: latency
method.description: Sets the internal processing latency in samples.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes output generation. Set to 0 to resume.

method.name: verbose
method.description: Enables or disables verbose diagnostic logging to the Max console.

method.name: setodds
method.description: Specifies relative likelihood weights for each of the 20 internal DSP processes.

method.name: tcycle
method.description: Defines a sequence list of transposition factors applied successively on each trigger.

method.name: gozero
method.description: Resets the transposition cycle pointer back to the beginning of the sequence.

method.name: grab
method.description: Copies the currently generated processed sound back into the primary target buffer.

method.name: maximum_process
method.description: Sets the maximum number of random DSP routines applied to each note (default: 2).

method.name: minimum_process
method.description: Sets the minimum number of random DSP routines applied to each note (default: 0).

method.name: setbuf
method.description: Re-binds the object to read and write from a different buffer~.

method.name: printmem
method.description: Posts the dynamic heap memory allocation size in megabytes for this instance to the Max console.
